page.notes: The sequence of short lines on this page is set with a printed » at the start of each line, which looks like a quotation or marking device rather than text; it is not transcribed. "abheredib" is my best reading of the line-end "abhe" and the next line's "redib."; it is uncertain and marked [?]. The running head is decorative and I could not read it. "plu" and "abhe" end their lines with no printed hyphen, so they are written whole. The page ends mid-word at "In-fir-", which is kept as a fragment.
